scope: PUBLIC DEVELOPMENT ONLY; falsification of 128-byte native public-causal-cell memory substrate
native_interface: PublicCausalCells.observe(address, action, public_outcome), choose(address), snapshot(), restore()
context_public_encoding: context id 0..7 exactly represents public bits (x0,x1,x2) in low-to-high order, with id7 stored in retained slot0 because active addresses 0..6; context is not the causal law or private label.
outcome: public binary success reward = int(action == hidden optimal action fn(public_bits))
intervention_budget: For each of 6 candidate laws, 8 public action-outcome trials per action per each of 4 training contexts = 64 events/world; no post-training updates before cold or transfer queries.
test_budget: 4 disjoint held-out context queries per law, 24 total. Both arms have never been observed at any held-out context.
controls: Native PublicCausalCells, no source-provided semantic relation map
Exact raw-event retrieval from identical 64 public events/world
Symbolic full hypothesis class with precisely disclosed six-function prior (not a prior-matched control; intentionally advantaged)
requirements: 6 law signatures uniquely identifiable from public TRAIN observations under the disclosed symbolic prior
No causal world law passed to native or raw retrieval learner
Check correct training-context preference for native; separate heldout abstention measurement

classification_rules.candidate_gain: At least one correct native heldout answer that exact retrieval abstains on WITHOUT supplied relation map; requires independent strong prior-matched control and separate prospective validation before any scientific claim.
classification_rules.native_no_generalization: Native heldout 0/24 coverage when symbolic-prior control uniquely identifies each law; this is DEV representation limit only, not generic impossibility or scientifically confirmatory evidence.
classification_rules.invalid: Any nonunique training law signatures, private causal-law leak to native, changed budget, mismatched source module SHA, failed deterministic snapshot, executor source drift or failed tests.
classification_rules.scientific_pass: FORBIDDEN FOR THIS OPEN DEV STUDY

notes: This is the genuine existing native 128-byte histogram-memory component, NOT the full Yggdrasil native research architecture; hypothesis-library symbolic baseline has an explicit privileged structural prior. The example is intentionally limited and simple: it can reject claims that these cells autonomously learn invariants across new addresses, not prove an AGI substrate is impossible.
security: No paid APIs, no Qwen weights, no LLM training, no original FIT/TRANSFER/RESERVED first use, no model weights, no promotion, no controller/queue/scheduler, no use of F19 data for tuning.
